DESCRIPTION_EN: ASA Agrotech, a global leader in clean-label wild bird food, unveils its flagship brand Happy Wings at SuperZoo 2025 (Booth No. 8041) . Known for a science-driven, quality-first approach, Happy Wings is transforming bird nutrition for North America. With today’s bird lovers and pet parents demanding higher standards, Happy Wings answers with a new generation of nutrition—100% natural, human-grade, and extra cleaned bird seed blends. These innovative mixes feature the exclusive No Grow Seed technology , specially processed to prevent sprouting beneath feeders, keeping patios and gardens pristine. The blends contain no artificial treatments, dyes, or chemicals , and are designed to meet the seasonal and nutritional needs of wild birds, backed by rigorous cleaning and safety protocols for purity and freshness. (BDI) ASA is proud to announce its exclusive distribution partnership with Boston Distribution Inc. (BDI), a family-owned and operated leader based in Darien, Wisconsin. Spearheaded by James and Julie Boston, BDI is a pioneer in the U.S. distribution landscape—renowned for its warehouse and drop shipping capabilities and dedicated support for e-commerce businesses since 2016. Their expertise ensures prompt nationwide distribution, seamless logistics, and unparalleled service for customers and retailers across the United States. “Happy Wings is all about setting a new standard in wild bird food—unmatched purity, natural goodness, and practical innovations that make feeding both joyful and hassle-free. With BDI as our U.S. partner, we’re excited to make these products accessible to Bird lovers and retailers throughout the country,” said Vinit Jhawat, Director - ASA Agrotech Excellence in Manufacturing & Certifications ASA’s facility operates under strict international quality and safety standards and is among only four globally USDA-approved facilities for treating Nyjer Seed. DESCRIPTION_EN: Media Contact: Susan Thibeault info@beaktivity.com Beaktivity – Bird Toys That Make Sense Named New Products Showcase Award Winner During Global Pet Expo 2025 (March, 2025) – Beaktivity the Bird Toys That Make Sense brand is pleased to announce it was recognized not once but twice during Global Pet Expo’s 15 th annual New Products Showcase “Best in Show” Awards , revealing the top pet products hitting the market in 2025. Presented by the American Pet Products Association (APPA) and Pet Industry Distributors Association (PIDA), Beaktivity’s Bird Toys Bases were named Best in Show First Place in the BIRD Category. Beaktivity’s Bird Toy Refill Kits were named Best in Show Second Place in the SUSTAINABLE PET Category. “We are delighted to be acknowledged for our experience led innovation to bring safe, all natural foraging and entertainment products that are sustainable to the avian community.” – Susan Thibeault, Partner and Co-Founder The New Products Showcase features the latest products and designs hitting the market each year. Award winners are selected based on the voting results of international and domestic buyers, media and influencers attending Global Pet Expo. The “Best in Show” Awards ceremony recognizes the year’s best creative and innovative efforts in new products across 13 categories. Winners were announced during Global Pet Expo, the pet industry’s premier event featuring the newest, most innovative pet products on the market today. “The innovation showcased at this year’s Global Pet Expo reflects the dynamic growth and resilience of the pet industry,” said APPA President & CEO Pete Scott. “These award-winning products highlight the creativity and commitment of brands that are not only meeting the evolving needs of pet owners but also strengthening the deep bond between people and their pets.” For more information about the New Products Showcase Awards and Global Pet Expo, visit GlobalPetExpo.org . ABOUT BEAKTIVITY Beaktivity is a family-run business built from a lifelong passion for avian care and enrichment. Founded by John and Sue, dedicated bird lovers with experience caring for a wide range of avian species—from pigeons to peacocks to parrots—our journey has always been guided by a deep commitment to bird welfare. For over a decade, we have actively volunteered with a local parrot rescue, fostering and rehabilitating parrots in our home while helping them find loving, permanent homes. Our own flock includes three macaws and three cockatoos, all adopted, along with our rescue dog, Ike. Even our two daughters, ages 6 and 9, are part of the business—helping assemble toys and learning the importance of responsible pet care. As a home-based small business, we prioritize sustainability and ethical sourcing. We proudly support other small businesses whenever possible and are committed to reducing waste. In fact, one of the driving forces behind Beaktivity was our desire to create sustainable, refillable bird toys. We even compost the used components of our toys, ensuring that our love for birds extends to caring for the planet, too. ABOUT GLOBAL PET EXPO Global Pet Expo, the pet industry’s premier event, is presented by the American Pet Products Association (APPA) and Pet Industry Distributors Association (PIDA). The show features more than 1,000 exhibitors, 3,500 booths, and over 3,000 new product launches annually, gathering nearly 20,000 pet professionals from around the world. Global Pet Expo is open to independent retailers, distributors, mass-market buyers, media, influencers and other qualified professionals. For more information, visit GlobalPetExpo.org and follow Global Pet Expo on Facebook , Instagram , LinkedIn , X , YouTube and TikTok . ABOUT THE AMERICAN PET PRODUCTS ASSOCIATION Founded in 1958, the American Pet Products Association (APPA) is a membership organization for the pet industry focused on business, relationships and innovation through services and programs designed to help its members prosper. APPA’s mission is to build a connected and informed community with a genuine passion for all things pet. As the leading pet trade association, APPA advances and unites the pet industry through key initiatives that gather, inform and connect APPA members, industry leaders and the pet community to advance innovation and enrich the lives of pets and the people who love them. Through the APPA Gives Back program, APPA is proud to support organizations that benefit humans and pets: the Human Animal Bond Research Institute (HABRI), Joybound People & Pets, the Pet Giving Network, the Pet Advocacy Network and Pets in the Classroom. Visit AmericanPetProducts.org for more information, and follow APPA on Facebook , Instagram , LinkedIn , X and YouTube . ABOUT THE PET INDUSTRY DISTRIBUTORS ASSOCIATION Pet Industry Distributors Association (PIDA) is the premier trade association representing the interests of pet product distributors since 1968. The mission of PIDA is to enhance the well-being of the wholesaler-distributor, to promote partnerships with their suppliers and customers and to work cooperatively with other organizations in fostering the human animal bond. PIDA is also proud to grow and support the industry through the following initiatives: the Human Animal Bond Research Institute (HABRI, Pet Advocacy Network and Pet Care Trust and Pets in the Classroom . Visit PIDA.org for more information and follow us on LinkedIn .

DESCRIPTION_EN: A fashion design director, having worked most notably at Ralph Lauren, DVF, and Donna Karan, Ivy resides in NYC where Bespoke Paws is designed and developed. After nearly 20 years living in New York, originally from Hawaii moving across the Pacific, it's fair to say Ivy had lived a bold life before her pup Brooklyn arrived. A self-described "island girl living in the Big Apple world" Ivy has an insatiable quest for unique, alluring, yet classic styles. Ivy launched Bespoke Paws in 2019, providing refined, luxury and sophisticated pet products. With both Ready-to-Wear and bespoke or Couture options, she is able to create the perfect piece for her clients. With her background in fashion, Ivy is mindful of each part of the process which helps to alleviate excess waste while maintaining high quality merchandise. Not just a merchandise company, Bespoke Paws is committed to animal welfare and is passionate about bringing awareness to causes. It is the brand's commitment to support homeless animals and encourage pet adoption using their online sales channel as a platform. With a strong belief that every pet is special and deserves the best, Ivy believes in the importance of quality, design, and social responsibility, aiming to inspire customers to be mindful in their choices and consider adoption. Ivy and Bespoke Paws believes in the individuality of each pet as a cherished family member, therefore they offer only the best with the highest of standards in the pet industry.

NAME_EN: BetterBone & Blue Standard Inc. to Unveil Game-Changing Innovations at SuperZoo Las Vegas 2025
NAME_KR: BetterBone & Blue Standard Inc. to Unveil Game-Changing Innovations at SuperZoo Las Vegas 2025
DESCRIPTION_EN: BetterBone & Blue Standard Inc. to Unveil Game-Changing Innovations at SuperZoo Las Vegas 2025 Las Vegas, NV — SUPERZOO 2025 – BetterBone, the award-winning sustainable dog chew brand, and its parent company, Blue Standard Inc., are thrilled to announce their participation in SuperZoo 2025 in Las Vegas, where they will debut a suite of groundbreaking innovations poised to redefine the future of pet products and packaging. Visitors to the BetterBone booth will experience an exciting showcase of all-new BetterBone products and flavors , including the latest venison launch in both medium and hard densities , and the highly anticipated mini size chews , designed especially for small dogs. These new releases continue BetterBone’s mission to offer a healthier, safer, and more sustainable alternative to traditional nylon, rawhide, and plastic-based chews. But that’s just the beginning. Blue Standard Inc. will unveil proprietary new bio-based materials designed to revolutionize the entire pet industry. In partnership with AGRANA , one of Europe’s leading dietary starch and sustainable biopolymer innovators, Blue Standard is introducing new home-compostable and biodegradable starch films and next-generation bio-materials developed to eliminate single-use plastics, ELIMINATE MICROPLASTICS from pet product packaging, poop bags, and beyond. These European-made materials are: Fully home-compostable Bio-based and MICRO-PLASTIC Designed for high-performance and low-impact Ideal for packaging, bags, and injection-molded applications “We're not just here to show new products,” said Chisholm Weaver, CEO of Blue Standard Inc. “We’re here to introduce materials and innovations that push the entire industry forward — with the highest levels of safety, sustainability, and performance, all proudly made in the EU and heading towards USA." BetterBone & Blue Standard Inc. has already been recognized as one of the Top 20 Most Sustainable Pet Brands of 2024 by the Pet Sustainability Coalition and continues to lead with innovation, quality, and purpose.

NAME_EN: Finfare Pet Foods Returns to the Spotlight at SuperZoo 2025 After Breakout Debut at Global Pet Expo
NAME_KR: Finfare Pet Foods Returns to the Spotlight at SuperZoo 2025 After Breakout Debut at Global Pet Expo
DESCRIPTION_EN: Fine Seafood, Perfected for Pets – Unmatched Taste, Nutrition, and Sustainability FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE – June 30, 2025 – Brooklyn, NY - After making waves with its official debut at Global Pet Expo in March, Finfare Pet Foods is making a bold return to the tradeshow stage—this time at SuperZoo 2025 in Las Vegas (August 13-15) . Energized by an overwhelmingly positive industry response and several major milestones since its launch, Finfare is coming to SuperZoo ready to amplify its presence and expand its retail and distribution partnerships. “Global was our first step into the pet industry, and the reception was nothing short of incredible,” said Gabriel Viteri, CEO of Finfare Pet Foods. “We left Orlando energized by the feedback from retailers, buyers, and pet parents—and since then, we’ve been busy turning that excitement into action.” Among Finfare’s biggest post-Global milestones is the launch of its direct-to-consumer platform , giving pet parents across the U.S. immediate access to its premium lineup of sashimi-grade, freeze-dried seafood treats for dogs and cats. Finfare’s treats are crafted using Cold Craft™ Technology , a proprietary process inspired by traditional cold-smoking and modern freeze-drying methods. This method locks in nutrients and flavor without the need for fillers, artificial additives, or heat processing. With unmatched freshness and a flavor pets crave, Finfare’s product lineup includes: For Dogs : Salmon Skin Strips, Salmon Nuggets, Salmon Bites, and Salmon Crumbles (Treat/Topper) For Cats : Salmon Skin Bites, Salmon Nuggets, and Salmon Sprinkles (Toppers). Coming Soon : Tuna Crumbles – an ultra-flavorful topper and treat for cats Each treat is rich in functional nutrients: 2x the Omega-3 & Omega-6 Fatty Acids of leading salmon treats – supports healthy skin and coat High DHA Content – supports cognitive function Premium Protein with Amino Acids – helps maintain strong, lean muscles Rich in Taurine – supports heart and vision health “We’re not just another treat brand—we’re seafood specialists bringing unmatched discipline, integrity, and taste to the category,” said Viteri. “SuperZoo is the perfect stage to showcase what’s next.” Finfare will exhibit at SuperZoo Booth #4509 . Products are available now on Finfarepetfoods.com , Amazon.com , and select specialty retailers nationwide. ## About Finfare Finfare is redefining pet nutrition from sea to bowl with Fine Seafood, Perfected for Pets . By combining over a century of seafood expertise with a passion for quality, sustainability, and innovation, Finfare delivers pure, premium seafood treats that elevate pet snacking. Every step, from sourcing to processing, is meticulously designed to provide pets with the very best seafood nature has to offer. For more information, visit Finfarepetfoods.com and follow @finfarepetfoods on social media. Media Contact: Karen Lu press@finfarepetfoods.com

NAME_EN: Morris Packaging To Build New Nearly $61 Million Flexible Packaging Operation,
NAME_KR: Morris Packaging To Build New Nearly $61 Million Flexible Packaging Operation,
DESCRIPTION_EN: FRANKFORT, Ky. (April 10, 2025) – Today, Gov. Andy Beshear congratulated Morris Packaging, a leading Minority Business Enterprise-certified manufacturer of flexible products, on plans to build a new $60.9 million production plant in Marion County, a project that will create 276 full-time jobs. “I’d like to welcome Morris Packaging to Marion County and to their New Kentucky Home, as well as the 276 quality jobs the company will create with this investment,” said Gov. Beshear . “This is the latest company to recognize the value of locating in Kentucky and the many strengths our state offers to ensure businesses thrives. Morris Packaging will be a great addition to our sustainability efforts and to our manufacturing sector, which continues to diversify and grow.” The more-than-100,000-square-foot facility in Lebanon will provide Morris Packaging with increased printing and bag converting capacity and provide a redundancy option to its customers across the United States. As a leader in sustainable packaging products, this state-of-the-art production plant will be Safe Quality Food-certified and allow the company room to grow in the future. Construction on the new facility in Lebanon is expected to be completed by October.

NAME_EN: PetAg® Debuts New Dyne™ Chews at SUPERZOO
NAME_KR: PetAg® Debuts New Dyne™ Chews at SUPERZOO
DESCRIPTION_EN: PetAg ® Debuts New Dyne™ Chews at SUPERZOO Leading Animal Nutrition Brand Introduces Dyne™ Dog Chews for Targeted Health Support Hampshire, Illinois – PetAg , a leader in pet nutrition and wellness, is making waves at SUPERZOO 2025 with the exciting debut of Dyne™ Chew Supplements – a bold expansion of the trusted Dyne line into a tasty, convenient soft chew format designed to support dogs’ health and vitality at every life stage. This launch marks a major milestone in PetAg’s nearly 100-year legacy of innovation, blending scientific precision with premium ingredients to deliver daily wellness support that dogs love and pet parents trust. For over 95 years, PetAg has been a champion of pet health, offering science-backed, vet-formulated solutions that pet parents can rely on. The new Dyne Chews line brings that legacy to life with targeted, functional soft chews that support energy, digestion, calm behavior, and joint health. Each chew is powered by clinically studied ingredients at effective dosages, tailored to meet the everyday needs of dogs—whether they’re active, aging, recovering, or simply living their best lives. The Dyne Chews lineup includes: Dyne™ Digestion & Immunity Advanced Support – Promotes a healthy gut and strong immune defenses, ideal for dogs facing dietary changes, stress, or aging. Dyne™ Joint Health & Mobility Advanced Support – Supports flexibility, comfort, and long-term joint function to help dogs stay active and agile. Dyne™ Energy & Endurance Advanced Support – Fuels stamina, strength, and metabolism—perfect for active, underweight, or recovering dogs. Dyne™ Calming Advanced Support – Helps reduce stress and promote emotional balance during common triggers like loud noises, travel, or separation—without causing drowsiness. “We’re proud to introduce Dyne Chews at SUPERZOO,” said Jonathan Ochoa, Vice President of Marketing at PetAg. “For nearly 100 years, PetAg has earned the trust and credibility of pet parents by delivering exactly what we promise—no fluff, no fillers, just effective ingredients at the proper levels. Dyne Chews continue that legacy, making it easy to proactively support your dog’s health with formulas you can feel good about—every single day.” SUPERZOO attendees are invited to visit Booth #10541 to explore the full Dyne Chews line, preview the latest innovations across PetAg’s portfolio, and meet the passionate team behind the brand’s trusted formulations. About PetAg, Inc. PetAg is a trusted leader in pet nutrition and wellness, offering science-backed milk replacers, nutritional supplements, and grooming products that support proactive health across every life stage. Proudly 100% employee-owned and based in Hampshire, Illinois, PetAg has delivered uncompromising quality since 1930. With a legacy rooted in innovation—beginning with Esbilac®, the first commercially prepared puppy milk replacer—PetAg is now the #1 brand in newborn kitten and puppy nutrition. Our portfolio includes beloved brands like KMR®, Esbilac®, GME®, Dyne®, Cat-Sip®, Fresh 'n Clean®, and Bene-Bac®, trusted by generations of pet parents and professionals alike. Backed by over 83,000 five-star reviews online, PetAg is more than a product provider—we’re a partner in pet wellness. Our purpose is to empower pet owners to proactively enhance the lives of their animals, helping them enjoy more healthy, happy years together. Every product we make reflects that commitment, combining proven science, purposeful ingredients, and a passion for pets.

NAME_EN: Polkadog at Boston Fish Pier Introduces Responsibly Sourced Salmon Skins to Their Premier Line of Single-Ingredient, Sustainably Produced Fish Treats
NAME_KR: Polkadog at Boston Fish Pier Introduces Responsibly Sourced Salmon Skins to Their Premier Line of Single-Ingredient, Sustainably Produced Fish Treats
DESCRIPTION_EN: The iconic Boston neighborhood kitchen adds Salmon Skins Smoked Jerky to their 1% for the Planet initiative. Boston, MA – Polkadog, creators of the industry’s original Cod Skins and advocates for healthy, sustainably-sourced pet treats, is introducing a new single ingredient fish treat: Polkadog Salmon Skins. Handmade in the USA at Polkadog’s Boston Fish Pier kitchen, salmon skins are slowly dehydrated to create the perfect, savory jerky treat. Like Polkadog’s Cod Skins, Salmon Skins are made from a single, sustainable, healthy ingredient. ​​Polkadog has pledged 1% of annual Salmon and Cod Skins sales to support environmentally focused nonprofits through the 1% for the Planet initiative. “Fish treats are what Polkadog does best,” Polkadog owner, Deb Suchman, says. “Our company is located at Boston’s Fish Pier.  We specialize in making single- and limited ingredient fish treats, and though it often goes unsaid, we deeply appreciate our role in preserving the health of our oceans and coastal communities.  I learned in a 2024 Pet Sustainability webinar that protein sourcing accounts for approximately 75% of the global pet food industry’s impact on the environment. Not only that, but the demand for proteins used in pet food is outpacing protein production globally. Pet treat and food brands need to reconsider the proteins used, how they’re sourced, and how we can commit to better, more sustainable business practices.” Fish is a healthy, hypoallergic protein source for dogs. It’s easily digestible, relatively low in saturated fats, and an excellent source of Omega-3 fatty acids, which help reduce inflammation and support healthy skin and coat. Polkadog Salmon Skins are a natural fit in their assortment of seafood treats, alongside their Cod Skins, Haddock Skins, Salmon Says, Green Monstah, Atlantic Silverside, and Clam Chowda. Polkadog Salmon Skins will be available to ship to independent retailers across the country late April via their distribution partners Pet Food Experts and Pet Palette. About Polkadog: Polkadog, Boston’s iconic pet boutique kitchen, is one of the pet industry’s most trusted pioneers of sustainable, community-based partnerships.  Since 2002, Polkadog has advocated for handmade, single and limited ingredient treats sourced from co-product and upcycled USA-based partnerships.  Located at Boston’s Fish Pier, Polkadog works closely with the most respected fishing companies and communities in New England. Polkadog is dedicated to doing things the right way, in return making a positive impact in the pet industry. About 1% for the Planet: 1% for the Planet is a global organization that exists to ensure our planet and future generations thrive. They act as an accountability partner for businesses supporting environmental partners through annual membership. They make environmental giving easy and effective through partnership advising, impact storytelling, and third-party certification. Today, 1% for the Planet’s global network consists of thousands of businesses and environmental partners working toward a better future. Learn more at onepercentfortheplanet.org . For more information about Polkadog, visit polkadog.com Marketing: kelsey@polkadog.com Director of Sales, East: patrick@polkadog.com Director of Sales, West: allie@polkadog.com ###

NAME_EN: Portland Pet Food Company Returns to SuperZoo as the Original  Pioneer in Shelf-Stable Fresh Pet Meals
NAME_KR: Portland Pet Food Company Returns to SuperZoo as the Original  Pioneer in Shelf-Stable Fresh Pet Meals
DESCRIPTION_EN: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Portland Pet Food Company Returns to SuperZoo as the Original Pioneer in Shelf-Stable Fresh Pet Meals New product launches, national retail growth, and a spot on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list mark a breakout year for the human-grade pet food pioneer Las Vegas, NV – (August 13, 2025) – Portland Pet Food Company, the brand that brought fresh, gently cooked meals to the shelf-stable pet category, returns to SuperZoo (August 13-15) with significant momentum—new product innovation, national retail expansion, and recognition as one of the fastest-growing wet food brands in the country. Recognized for redefining what shelf-stable pet food can be, Portland Pet Food Company crafts gently cooked, human-grade meals with 11 or fewer whole-food ingredients—no synthetic supplements or artificial fillers. Unlike pouch-based entrants mimicking canned food, PPFC’s recipes look, smell, and taste like real food because they are. “We weren’t inspired by a trend—we started from scratch in a kitchen, solving real mealtime challenges for our own pets,” said Founder Katie McCarron. “Now, as the market catches on to what fresh really means, we’re proud to lead with integrity, transparency, and results.” New at SuperZoo: Two Product Launches Built for Pet Parent Needs At Booth #2503, PPFC will debut: ● Winnie’s Lamb N’ Rice – Inspired by Katie’s own pup, this new meal offers a gentle, novel protein recipe for sensitive stomachs and picky eaters. ● New Multi-Variety 4-Pack (in-store only) – Featuring PPFC’s top-selling Beef, Chicken, Salmon, and Pork recipes, this bundle supports rotational feeding, making it easier for pet parents to vary proteins and support better digestion without complex transitions. Momentum Backed by Milestones PPFC arrives at SuperZoo celebrating: ● A place on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing privately held companies in America ● Growth to over 7,000 retail locations across the U.S., Canada, and Asia ● #1 fastest-selling major brand in the wet dog food category, according to SPINS data, *Among brands with an ACV of at least 30% ● Continued sales velocity in key accounts fueled by rising demand for real-food nutrition With strong demand from both consumers and retail partners, PPFC remains focused on offering clean-label, flexible nutrition that works within real-world routines—and doesn't require freezers, fuss, or full diet overhauls. Built for Retail Success PPFC’s products are shelf-stable, space-efficient, and proven to deliver strong cost-per-pound trade-up value. The brand helps complement existing kibble purchases rather than cannibalize them, offering retailers an easy way to grow basket size while meeting rising shopper demand for real-food nutrition. For more information, visit portlandpetfoodcompany.com. About Portland Pet Food Company Portland Pet Food Company (PPFC) is a woman-owned and led business in Portland, Oregon that makes human-grade pet food and treats with 100% U.S.-sourced human-grade ingredients. Founded in 2014 by Katie McCarron after discovering the benefits of human-grade food for her aging dog Rosie, PPFC now offers simple recipes with 11 or fewer ingredients and no preservatives. The company serves pets across the U.S., Canada, and parts of Asia. PPFC has earned recognition as a Top 10 Social Steward pet food brand by the Pet Sustainability Coalition and recognized by the Upcycled Food Association Certification while being named among the Top 50 Fastest-Growing Women's Businesses in 2025. ### PRESS CONTACT: portlandpetfoodcompany@jessuppr.com

Firefighters will use the strobing feature to navigate through thick smoke and save the precious time needed to rescue pets from fires. A must have for every pet owner. Included with the Rescue Retriever is our custom decal for exterior placement. This acts as the first notification when firefighters arrive, and also alerts that a Rescue Retriever smoke detector is inside.

NAME_EN: Sauder® Embraces the Humanization of Pets with New Line of Integrated Pet-Friendly Home Furniture
NAME_KR: Sauder® Embraces the Humanization of Pets with New Line of Integrated Pet-Friendly Home Furniture
DESCRIPTION_EN: ARCHBOLD, Ohio — July 8, 2025 — As pets continue to claim their rightful place in the hearts – and homes – of millions of Americans, Sauder® is proud to introduce at SuperZoo 2025 a thoughtfully designed line of furniture that supports the growing trend of treating pets as human family members. With 66% of U.S. households – approximately 86.9 million homes – now owning a pet, up from just 56% in 1988, the desire to seamlessly integrate pet comfort into everyday living is at an all-time high. Of those households with pets, 97% consider their pet to be a part of their family. Sauder’s latest product offerings respond to this trend – blending style, functionality, and comfort for both people and their pets. The new products feature multi-functional furniture pieces including bookcases, end tables, and storage cabinets – all designed with built-in spaces for pet crates or cozy beds. These designs allow pet owners to provide their animals designated areas that complement interior décor rather than disrupt it. “With the rise in more and more families treating their pets as true members of the household, we saw an opportunity for additional home organization solutions,” said Doug Krieger, VP of merchandising and design at Sauder®. “Our goal was to develop furniture that not only has great styling but also enhances the daily living experience for both pets and their people.” Expanding beyond traditional four-legged companions, Sauder has also introduced specialized stands for fish tanks and reptile habitats, further emphasizing its commitment to the diverse needs of modern pet owners. With prices ranging from $94 to $600, this new collection of pet-focused furniture offers stylish, practical solutions for households that want their furry, scaly, or finned companions to feel right at home – making high-quality, petfriendly design accessible to a broad customer base. Visit Sauder at SuperZoo Sauder’s newest collections will be available at booth #9066 , August 13-15, 2025, at Mandalay Bay Convention Center, Las Vegas, Nevada. About Sauder Sauder Woodworking Co. is North America’s leading producer of ready-to-assemble (RTA) furniture and one of the top five residential furniture manufacturers in the United States. Sauder also produces other wood products including contract furniture, and most recently kitchen cabinets and closets. An authentic American original, a majority of Sauder® furniture is manufactured in Archbold, Ohio – right where the company was founded in 1934. Although the town is small (pop. 4,300), the facility footprint is expansive. With some of the most technologically advanced equipment in the world, Sauder’s local facilities encompass nearly 4 million square feet of space, employ about 2,000 workers and house a wide variety of local and imported materials. Sauder also sources furniture from a network of quality global partners, all supported by domestic warehouses in three strategic locations. Learn more at Sauder.com . DESCRIPTION_EN: Veterinary-Formulated Pet Nutrition Now Available to More Independent Retailers Across Northern and Central California Austin, Texas – Summer 2025 – SquarePet® , the leading provider of purpose-driven, veterinarian-formulated pet nutrition, is pleased to announce a new distribution partnership with S&S Pet Supplies, a trusted, family-owned distributor serving independent retailers throughout Northern and Central California. Founded in 1970, S&S Pet Supplies brings over 50 years of experience, deep-rooted relationships, and a long-standing reputation for exceptional service in the pet specialty channel. Their focus on supporting independent retailers with high-quality products and hands-on partnership makes them an ideal fit for SquarePet’s growing portfolio. “We’re excited to partner with a distributor that shares our commitment to integrity, quality, and independent retail,” said Tyler Atkins, Chief Sales and Marketing Officer of SquarePet. “S&S has a remarkable history in this industry and understands what it takes to help retailers succeed. We’re honored to join their lineup.” Starting this summer, S&S will offer SquarePet’s complete range of veterinarian-developed diets; including solutions for digestive health, food sensitivities, and special needs - along with in-store education, merchandising support, and promotional resources. This collaboration furthers SquarePet’s mission to make premium, science-backed nutrition more accessible to pet families - without the need for a prescription - while driving meaningful growth for independent retailers. For more information on SquarePet’s full lineup, visit www.MySquarePet.com ### About SquarePet SquarePet Nutrition is driven by a commitment to continuous improvement and innovation, is made up of pet industry professionals, veterinarians, nutritionists, and manufacturing experts to supply new and reimagined nutritional formulations unique to the pet food industry.  SquarePet is a 100% family owned company that makes nutrition for the health of all breeds and ages of dogs and cats. Learn more at https://www.mysquarepet.com/ . NAME_EN: The dooloop was invented out of need, it has a story, values in manufacture and use, plus game changing utility for people who walk their dog
NAME_KR: The dooloop was invented out of need, it has a story, values in manufacture and use, plus game changing utility for people who walk their dog
DESCRIPTION_EN: The dooloop is the original leash accessory that is actually useful because it's easy to use. Why it's important to cover? If you're in the press, which if you're reading this, you likely are, I'd like to ask you to pause for a second, visualize someone handing you a bag of their poop, you walking, holding it looking for a trash can. Millions of people walking their dog do this (dog poop = people poop, it's not manure). Gross right? Sure, you might help that friend out once, but daily? Well, our dogs are our besties, and they are doing what they need because it's their option by design, not choice. We're picking it up because it's our obligation: poop left to 'melt', is releasing all kinds of bad bacteria, potentially parasites, into the environment including our aquifers, supplying our taps! At the dooloop we can talk about s**t all day, in 2025 we've got even more to talk about with a new multi-patented  dooloop 2 and something else that you can hear about if you come to the booth. The dooloop is a product that is the whole package: cute, economical, convenient, made in the USA sustainably & ethically (jobs!), environmentally responsible and good margins for Main St stores. Woman-owned. CU :)

NAME_EN: WonderFold Expands into Pet Gear with Launch of Three Innovative Pet Strollers at SuperZoo
NAME_KR: WonderFold Expands into Pet Gear with Launch of Three Innovative Pet Strollers at SuperZoo
DESCRIPTION_EN: WonderFold, the brand that revolutionized the stroller wagon category, is bringing its signature innovation and functionality to a new frontier: pet mobility. At this year’s SuperZoo, WonderFold proudly introduces its debut pet collection—three thoughtfully engineered strollers designed to elevate the way people travel with their pets. Known for disrupting the family gear market with versatile, high-capacity stroller wagons, WonderFold is now applying that same design-forward thinking to pet gear—proving that pets deserve the same level of comfort, convenience, and style. Meet the Lineup: PF Flat Fold Pet Stroller: Designed for compact living, this stroller features an ultra-flat fold (even the wheels fold in!) and rear entry for easy loading. Built-in leash clip, mesh windows, and a hidden privacy cover make it ideal for small to mid-sized pets. P3 2-in-1 Carrier + Stroller: This versatile, lightweight design transitions seamlessly from stroller to carrier. With dual entry points, mesh ventilation, and an adjustable handlebar, it’s built for convenience on the go. PXL Large Pet Stroller Wagon: The heavy-duty hauler for big pets or multiple companions, the PXL holds up to 330 lbs and features front and rear ramp-style entry, secure harness latches, and generous storage—all wrapped in WonderFold’s signature style and durability. “We’ve always believed in creating products that bring families closer together,” said Sabrina Ng, Founder and CO-CEO at WonderFold. “We transformed the way parents move with their kids, and now we’re ready to do the same for pet parents. This is more than a new product line—it’s the start of a new standard in pet mobility.” WonderFold Pet combines practicality with elevated design, offering solutions that meet the demands of modern pet ownership—whether it’s a trip to the vet, a day in the city, or a weekend adventure. The pet stroller collection will be available online and through select retailers beginning August 2025, with more accessories and innovations to come. Visit WonderFold at SuperZoo Booth #10941 to see the new pet strollers in action.
